item.description:
UNO Show 'Em No Mercy is a brutal, ruthless version of the classic UNO card game. In addition to standard action cards like Skip, Reverse, and Draw 2, No Mercy comes with Wild Draw 6, Wild Draw 10, Skip Everyone, Discard All, and the new Wild Color Roulette - a card that forces the next player to choose a color and then draw until they get a card of that color.
In addition to new action cards, many popular house rules have been included in the actual rules. Stacking is legal. 7s swap and 0s pass hands. And when you can't play a card, you must draw until you can play.
But the biggest change in UNO Show 'Em No Mercy is the Mercy Rule. If you ever have 25 or more cards in your hand, you get kicked out of the game.
UNO Show 'Em No Mercy comes with 168 cards (compared to 112 in standard UNO).

This UNO Show 'em No Mercy expansion pack adds some fresh, ruthless rules to your existing UNO Show 'em No Mercy deck! Simply mix in the expansion pack's 24 cards and bring carnage to the already brutal game! The expansion pack also includes special coins that can only be used once per round, so choose wisely! The Mercy Coin lets a player draw a whole new hand, and the No Mercy Coin doubles the penalty of any card played! Players must already have an UNO Show 'em No Mercy deck; the cards and coins in the expansion pack cannot be played with on their own.
Includes 24 cards, 6 coins and instructions.
—description from the publisher
As of 2025 in the U.S., this expansion is a Wal-Mart exclusive.
The card distribution is as follows:
8 #10 Cards, marked with a "Ten Replay Modifier" that lets the player who plays it immediately take another turn (similar to the "Skip Everyone" Cards, but these are considered Number Cards instead of Action Cards (see below). 8 Wild Discard All Cards; when played, you choose a color and discard all the cards you hold of that color. You then choose a color (the same color as discarded or any other color) to continue play. 4 Wild Reverse Draw Eight Cards; essentially, the same as the Wild Reverse Draw Four Cards in the base deck, but the next player in the new direction draws eight cards and loses their turn. You then choose the color that continues play. 2 Wild Final Attack Cards; when played, you reveal your hand. The next player must draw one card for each Action and Wild Card you hold and lose their turn. (This excludes the Number Cards with modifiers--0, 7 and 10.) But if you have 7 or more Action/Wild cards in your hand, the next player has to draw 25 cards, and every other player (except you) draws 5 cards. You then choose the color that continues play. 2 Wild Sudden Death Cards; when played, EVERY player (including you) draws enough cards to bring their hand to 24 cards. You then choose the color that continues play.
The Mercy/No Mercy coin is taken before play and its function must be chosen before cards are dealt out, and can only be used once per deal.
If you choose to use the Mercy side, you can use it whenever you want to discard your entire hand to the bottom of the Discard Pile and draw a new hand of 7 cards from the Draw Pile. (This can also be used whenever your hand is over 25 cards to avoid elimination.)
If you choose the No Mercy side, whenever you play a Draw Action/Wild Card, you can play the coin to DOUBLE the Draw penalty of THAT CARD ONLY. (Example: Playing a Wild Reverse Draw Eight, then playing a No Mercy coin doubles that card's draw penalty to 16.) It does not affect any other cards in any accumulated Draw pile, and it doesn't affect the card's value when adding cards to said accumulation. (Continuing the above example, another Draw Eight or Draw Ten could be played on the card, but the coin still only affects the penalty from the originally played card. But you could NOT play a Draw Four and another No Mercy coin and consider it a Draw Eight.)

item.description:
This is a travel-sized promotional card game released globally as a headlining part of the 2026 McDonald's "UNO x Anime" Happy Meal crossover campaign. Packed inside a sleek grey box featuring the secret agent Loid Forger (Twilight), this officially licensed mini-deck adapts the classic Mattel formula into a condensed 43-card architecture engineered for 2 to 4 players.
The deck spans four colorful suits matching the core aesthetics of the series, featuring character illustrations of the Forger family—including Loid, Yor, Anya, and their dog Bond—alongside prominent supporting characters like Yuri, Damian, and Becky. The objective remains faithful to standard UNO: match colors or numbers to be the first to dump your hand, navigating a leaner lineup of Draw 1, Skip, and Reverse action cards.
This set features a franchise-exclusive holographic foil "Anya Mind Reader" Wild Card. When played, the active player names the target color to change the play, then forces all opponents to tilt their card hands forward for a brief three-second window. This telepathic peek gives the player a massive strategic advantage to safely plan their remaining turns or perfectly orchestrate incoming color shifts.
